tooltip.jaymospowers.heart_crystal: Consume for a permanent half-heart. Lost on death, but each grants an extra life.
message.jaymospowers.hearts.granted: A heart crystal takes root in you. (%s half-hearts)
message.jaymospowers.hearts.full: You cannot hold more heart crystals.
message.jaymospowers.hearts.burned: A heart crystal shatters, turning death aside. (%s half-hearts remain)
